notes: D20_4_main: the smallest 7-cluster of Kurz-Noll-Rathbun-Simmons (diameter 2262000) is checked: integral distances, no three collinear, no four on a circle with integer equation A(x^2+y^2)+Dx+Ey+F=0, A != 0. Outside Lean: every circle through lattice points has such an integer equation (rational centre).

sources.cite: S. Kurz, L. C. Noll, R. Rathbun, C. Simmons, Constructing 7-clusters, Serdica J. Computing 8 (2014) 47-70

prior_art.note: Kreisel-Kurz 2008 heptagons are not lattice sets; the lattice question was answered by Noll-Simmons.
